title: Decision Fatigue: Why You Buy Junk at Night

visual.description: A close-up of a digital battery icon on a dark screen, glowing with energy and slowly depleting.

vo.en: It’s why you easily resist donuts at noon, but find yourself face-first in a late-night pizza by midnight.
vo.fr: Voilà pourquoi tu résistes sans effort à midi, mais tu finis par craquer pour une pizza à minuit.

visual.description: A man in a kitchen looking at a healthy salad, then a fast cut to a man opening a pizza box in a dark room.

vo.en: Many call this decision fatigue—that heavy, foggy feeling when your brain’s processing power is simply exhausted.
vo.fr: C'est la fatigue décisionnelle : cette impression de brouillard quand ton cerveau n'en peut plus de réfléchir.

visual.description: A man rubbing his temples in a dimly lit office, looking exhausted and staring at a screen.

vo.en: Every tiny choice, from choosing your socks to replying to one last email, slowly saps your mental reserves.
vo.fr: Chaque petit choix, des chaussettes au moindre e-mail, vide progressivement tes réserves d'énergie.

visual.description: Fast cuts of a man's hands choosing clothes from a closet, then typing rapidly on a laptop keyboard.

vo.en: Once your energy hits zero, your self-control snaps. Suddenly, mindless scrolling and impulse buying feel impossible to stop.
vo.fr: Quand l'énergie s'épuise, ton contrôle lâche. Le défilement infini et les achats impulsifs deviennent alors inévitables.

visual.description: A man's hand holding a credit card over a laptop at night, followed by fingers scrolling quickly on a phone.

vo.en: To fight back, automate your routine. Lay out your clothes and prep your meals before the sun even goes down.
vo.fr: Pour lutter, automatise ton quotidien. Prépare tes vêtements et tes repas avant même que le soleil ne se couche.

visual.description: A man setting out a pre-packed lunch container and a neatly folded outfit on a bed.

vo.en: Stop wasting your focus on the small stuff, so tomorrow morning...
vo.fr: Arrête de gaspiller ton attention, pour que demain matin...

visual.description: A cinematic shot of a city sunrise transitioning to a macro shot of a human eye opening.
